findings.statement: Runs on CPU as well as GPU: the README provides CPU environments for macOS and Windows, and the scripts accept -1 for CPU.
findings.source_says: README documents "-1" for CPU only for predict_ss_rna.py and the MRL script. extract_embedding.py has parser.add_argument("--device", default=0, type=int) and passes the integer straight to .to(device), with no handling of -1.
findings.fix: Runs on CPU as well as GPU: the README provides CPU environments for macOS and Windows, and the secondary structure and MRL scripts accept --device -1 for CPU.

summary: Reliable. Architecture, training data, context limit, checkpoints and licences match the Nature Communications full text, README, scripts and Drive listing, and the two disclosed command fixes in the run guide (environment name, --device type) are correct against the saved files.
